objections.claim: E1's sole credential-bearing merge controller never requires authenticated Eye acceptance for an ordinary implementation PR. Its pre-merge eligibility derives GitHub state, producer-bound checks, and protected-surface transition records, but only protected-surface transitions receive an Eye signature; Section 6's prose ordering (`review → Eye acceptance → step-ledger`) is not consumed or enforced by the controller. Consequently a model-produced ordinary PR with green checks can be merged without the Eye accepting that exact change, delegating consequential action to automation despite the non-delegable human-authority invariant. Require an Eye-signed pre-merge authorization whose canonical payload binds owner/repository, PR number, exact head SHA, current base SHA/ref, and active plan_ref; verify it immediately before the PUT, and add missing-acceptance, other-head/base/repository, and replay regressions proving no merge mutation occurs.
